subject: Marketplace addendum: order form pass-through + ops checklist
messages:
From: CloudWave Legal <legal@cloudwave.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Anna Li <anna.li@cloudwave.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudwave.com
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Marketplace addendum — pass-through fee flow

Jordan / team,

Thanks for the call this morning. Attached is the CloudWave internal draft of the marketplace/reseller addendum (v3). Two items to call out up front we want to confirm:

1) Fee pass-through: CloudWave requires a clean pass-through of marketplace fees so our invoicing to customers reflects the platform surcharge as a separate line item. Please confirm Redwood can support line-item passthrough on the order form and that tax handling won't be co-mingled.
2) Order Form referencing: we need the Order Form to reference the MSA by exact version (MSA v2.1) and include the reseller fee schedule as Exhibit B.

We attached a redline for your legal team. Can you confirm a target for redline turnaround and whether Redwood will provide a short ops checklist mapping order form fields to marketplace SKU IDs? Procurement would like to avoid a second loop after DocuSign.

Thanks,
Anna Li
Legal Ops | CloudWave Inc
Attachment: Marketplace_Addendum_v3_redline.docx (Word, 78KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@cloudwave.com>, CloudWave Legal <legal@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum — pass-through fee flow

Anna — thanks for the draft and clear asks. A quick read: both items are workable but will need a short legal + ops coordination loop. I looped in Kimberly (legal) and Ben (platform ops) to scope the changes and provide the checklist you requested.

Proposed timeline:
- Kimberly to send a redline with comments by end of day Thursday (3/18).
- Ben to draft an order-form-to-SKU mapping and a DocuSign preflight checklist by Friday (3/19).

Can you confirm whether CloudWave expects the pass-through to appear on Redwood’s invoice to CloudWave, or Redwood’s invoice to the end-customer (CloudWave’s buyer)? That will affect how we model tax and accounting.

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Partner Manager, Marketplace | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Li <anna.li@cloudwave.com>, CloudWave Legal <legal@cloudwave.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum — pass-through fee flow

Team — attached is Redwood's redline (high level summary below) and an ops preflight checklist stub. I kept CloudWave’s core pass-through ask intact but proposed language that:

- Clarifies invoicing flow: Redwood invoices CloudWave for platform usage; marketplace surcharge must be displayed as a separate line item on CloudWave's invoice to its end-customer. We cannot invoice the end-customer on behalf of CloudWave without a separate reseller agreement.
- Tax handling: explicit clause that taxes applied by cloud marketplace are remitted by the marketplace provider; Redwood will not recharacterize marketplace taxes.
- Order Form cross-reference: require Order Form to include the MSA version and Exhibit B attachment; recommended using a unique OrderForm_ID field to avoid ambiguous references.
- Indemnity carveout: limited carveout around third-party marketplace billing errors; CloudWave remains responsible for customer disputes tied to its pricing.

Ops checklist (stub):
- Confirm OrderForm_ID and attach Exhibit B (reseller fee schedule).
- Map Redwood SKU -> Marketplace SKU (column format) and include SKU version/date.
- DocuSign: include a preflight checklist item to verify external tax IDs and billing addresses.
- Billing test: execute a $1 test invoice to validate pass-through line items and tax display.

Attachment: Marketplace_Addendum_v3_redline.docx (Redwood comments)
Attachment: OrderForm_PassThrough_Ops_Checklist.xlsx (stub)

Ben — can you populate the SKU mapping and note any constraints with our invoicing engine (specifically whether we can surface marketplace_tax separate from platform_tax)? I will send this back to CloudWave with inline comments once you confirm.

-kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference

From: Anna Li <anna.li@cloudwave.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudWave Legal <legal@cloudwave.com>, procurement@cloudwave.com
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum — pass-through fee flow

Kim / Jordan — this is very helpful, thanks. Quick answers to your questions:

- Invoice direction: CloudWave invoices the end-customer; we need Redwood to show the marketplace surcharge as a discrete line item on Redwood’s billing output so our downstream invoicing can ingest it. We will not ask Redwood to bill our end-customer.
- Tax: CloudWave accepts the marketplace provider’s tax remittance note; we just need the tax line item exposed in CSV for reconciliation.

Next steps:
1) Kimberly to send final redline with the OrderForm_ID language and the limited indemnity carveout (agree EOD today if possible).
2) Ben to share SKU mapping and a short note on whether the billing export will include marketplace_tax as a separate column (Ben: procurement needs the csv column name).
3) After we confirm those two items we will schedule a 30-minute pre-Docusign sync (Anna + procurement + Jordan + Ben) — propose Friday 3/19 10:00 ET.

We will attach the procurement checklist to our internal PO once items are finalized.

Anna Li
Senior Procurement Manager | CloudWave Inc
Attachment: OrderForm_Terms_Summary.pdf (PDF, 44KB)
